title: Core: Ink bottle tool (apply stroke to shape)
description: Implement applyInkBottle(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, frameIdx, objectId, strokeColor, strokeWidth) in packages/core/src/engine/inkbottle.ts. Finds the target ShapeDisplayObject and adds or replaces the stroke on all its ShapePaths. Returns updated document immutably. Tests: apply stroke to path with no stroke, replace existing stroke, verify color and width.
